task.description: Implement the approved fix for ISS-0020 exactly per docs/agents/design/ISS-0020-fix.md: project users.blocked onto domain/user.ts's getUserByTgUsername (extend UserWithTelegram interface + query select), and gate both handlers/staff.ts notification sends (makeStaffAddHandler, makeStaffRemoveHandler) behind a blocked check that reuses the existing notificationFailed flag/notificationFailedNote message -- no new i18n key. Do not touch addEventStaff/removeEventStaff or the ledger/sendLedgeredNotification system.
acceptance_criteria: getUserByTgUsername's returned UserWithTelegram now includes blocked: boolean, sourced from users.blocked.
makeStaffAddHandler skips ctx.api.sendMessage and sets notificationFailed=true when targetUser.blocked is true, without entering the try block.
addEventStaff/removeEventStaff (the staff mutation itself) are untouched -- the mutation still commits regardless of blocked status.
No new i18n key introduced; the existing notificationFailedNote message is reused.
npm run lint -w apps/bot and npm run build -w apps/bot are clean.
Full existing suite (npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism) still passes.

result.summary: Applied the approved ISS-0020-fix.md design exactly. domain/user.ts: UserWithTelegram gained `blocked: boolean`; getUserByTgUsername's select now projects `blocked: users.blocked` alongside id/tgId/tgUsername -- confirmed via grep this function has exactly two callers, both in staff.ts, so the widened shape breaks nothing else. handlers/staff.ts: both makeStaffAddHandler and makeStaffRemoveHandler now check `if (targetUser.blocked) { notificationFailed = true; } else { try { ...ctx.api.sendMessage... } catch { notificationFailed = true; } }` -- the guard sits immediately before the existing try block, reuses the existing notificationFailed flag and its downstream notificationFailedNote surfacing, with no new i18n key added anywhere. addEventStaff/removeEventStaff run before this block, unchanged, and still commit the staff mutation regardless of blocked status -- S10 gates only the notification, not the admin action, per design. npm run lint -w apps/bot: clean, zero warnings/errors. npm run build -w apps/bot: clean, zero type errors (tsc -p tsconfig.json). npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism from repo root: 35 test files / 325 tests, all passed, 36.17s, no failures, no flakiness observed. No new test files were written at this step per WF-03's own procedure -- TEST-DESIGNER writes the fail-then-pass regression case at Step 4, next. Note on process: an earlier BACKEND-DEV dispatch for this same step left this exact diff uncommitted in the working tree (matching the design verbatim) but reported an internal wait-loop instead of completing normally; this run inspected that uncommitted diff, verified it against docs/agents/design/ISS-0020-fix.md line-by-line, re-ran lint/build/test myself rather than trusting any prior claim, and committed it -- no rework was needed, the stalled agent's actual code changes were already correct.
result.next_action: Route to REVIEWER (Step 3's review, same as WF-02 Step 2b).
